description: Maxwellian reactivity parametrisations and the extra S-factor fits needed to integrate them. Read by derivations/chapters/ch02_reactivity.py and ch04_power_balance.py. T is the ion temperature in keV, E the centre-of-mass energy in keV.

bosch_hale_reactivity.source: H.-S. Bosch and G. M. Hale, Nucl. Fusion 32, 611 (1992), https://doi.org/10.1088/0029-5515/32/4/I07, Table VII and eqs. (12)-(14). Values transcribed from two independent open implementations that cite Table VII: PlasmaPy src/plasmapy/utils/data/rxty_pade_polynomial_coefficients.json and ASCOT5 src/boschhale.c (identical digits).
bosch_hale_reactivity.form: <sigma v> = C1 theta sqrt(xi/(m_r c^2 T^3)) exp(-3 xi) [cm^3/s], theta = T / (1 - T (C2 + T (C4 + T C6)) / (1 + T (C3 + T (C5 + T C7)))), xi = (B_G^2/(4 theta))^(1/3)

bosch_hale_s_factor_extra.source: Bosch and Hale (1992), Table IV (S in keV mb, Pade form as in cross-sections.json); transcribed from ASCOT5 src/boschhale.c. Used only for the numerical cross-check of the D-3He reactivity and for D-T above 550 keV.

p11B.source: W. M. Nevins and R. Swain, Nucl. Fusion 40, 865 (2000), https://doi.org/10.1088/0029-5515/40/4/310: S(E) eqs. (2)-(4) and Table 1; high-T reactivity fit eq. (13)-(15), Table 2 (valid 50-500 keV, P1 gives m^3/s).
p11B.label: p + 11B -> 3 4He
